legend.text:
HOW TO READ THIS CANVAS

Written review: https://claude.ai/artifact/Dv38acPjCPNffg6Kxnf9dK

Top row: the four desktop editors as they ship today, redrawn at their real window sizes from the Solid code, with positions measured in a headless browser. Values are realistic stand-ins; a host would supply the real ones.

Bottom row: the proposed revision of each window. The sticky under each one lists its changes; the IDs (D1, S1, TG1, …) match the written review.

Only the Side-Chain proposal is interactive: switch Source in its Tweaks and the Trigger panel changes while nothing else moves.

Defects verified in the shipped build:
D1  TG: Paste sits past the 824px window edge; Copy and Paste are squeezed to 16px wide
D2  TG: Soft, Order and Shuffle are squeezed to 18px tall (system: 28)
D3  SC + LI: hint text truncates; the Motion switch sits 4px from the signature
D4  SC: hint bar 20px tall, 8px from the bottom edge (others: 28 / 16)
D5  SC: Delay (bipolar) draws its arc from the minimum, so 0 % looks half-way up

li-changes.text:
LISTEN-IN — CHANGES

S1   No 'NI Listen-In' title row.
LI2  The status is an LED (on / amber taken / red unavailable), not dim text.
LI3  Flat uv meter fill: no gradient, no 60 ms transition, radius 0.
LI4  The hint states conventions, not 'bus 3'.
LI5  The Bus select keeps 16 entries (taken buses disabled in the list): proposed as a documented exception to the 12-option cap.
LI6  No animated Ground in this utility window, so no Motion switch; that is what stops the hint truncating.

Window: 360 × 172 (was 232).

sc-changes.text:
SIDE-CHAIN — CHANGES

S1   No NI SIDE-CHAIN in the window: the host's title bar names it.
SC1  Source, rate, stage and total time go into the plot caption; the window's one amber mark sits at its right end.
SC2  Two real panels, DUCK and TRIGGER, instead of a bare knob row and two loose select rows.
SC3  The Trigger panel has a fixed size: changing Source swaps its contents and moves nothing else.
SC4  Note (128 options) and Channel (17) become stepped knobs; the system caps a Select at 12.
SC5  Square 8px handles; the caption no longer repeats the hint.
SC6  The input under the curve is drawn in line-200 rather than an off-palette grey.
D5   Delay draws its arc from 12 o'clock (bipolar).
S7   Mode (Trigger/Gate) and Time (ms/%) become switches.
S8   Full labels: SOURCE, CHANNEL, THRESHOLD, not Src / Ch / Thresh.
S2   The hint lists conventions only; '225 ms total' was a readout.

Window: 760 × 656 (was 604).

sp-changes.text:
SPECTROGRAM — CHANGES

S1   The SPECTROGRAM title row goes: the host names the window.
SP2  The Bars switch and the bar-count select are one setting: a Span select (13 s, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 bars).
SP3  Pause is the system's latching pause icon button.
SP4  Clash is ink hatching, not amber: amber is the system's state colour, and this window already spends it on 'no signal'.
S8   Group captions and readout keys in ink-muted; ink-dim is for disabled text.
SP6  Range, Span and Pause sit beside the crosshair readout, under the picture they set.
S2   Facts leave the hint: the range is in the Range select, history in Span, the floor in the level readout.

Window: 720 × 470 (was 502).

tg-changes.text:
TRANCE GATE — CHANGES

TG1  Copy patch, Paste patch and Randomize move out of the settings row into the Actions side column as joined icons. Fixes D1.
TG2  The system's glyphs (16px, 1.5px stroke) replace the hand-drawn 14px ones.
TG3  One plot instead of Pattern/Signal tabs: the Signal switch lays the measured signal behind the pattern. The tab strip and the 24px of hidden trace go.
TG4  The left column ends flush with the panel stack (500), not 84px above it; the envelope plot takes the height (204px, was 104).
TG5  Panel gutters 24 (space-6), not 16.
TG6  One settings row above the plot, in the original order: Slot, Join, Curve, Time in %, and Signal at the right end over the plot it controls. Without the window verbs it fits 760px with room to spare.
TG7  Button words in sentence case, verb first: Set order, Shuffle order.
TG8  Panels narrowed from 488 to 390: knobs keep 64px cells instead of stretching to 95.
D2   Fade's switches and buttons in two columns at the full 28px.
S6   Readouts formatted by the UI: 90 %, 15 ms (unit in ink-muted).
S7   Two-option selects become switches: Fade Dir → OUT, Env Time → TIME IN %.
S12  The ring is drawn as the system's display ring until the team decides on an editable variant.

Window: 824 × 768 (was 736): +32 from system spacing, 24px between control groups (was 16) and 16px above the plot (was 8).

cd-notes.text:
CHORD-DETECTOR — NEW WINDOW

A silent instrument for a MIDI lane: it names what is sounding. Interactive: a progression loops (Am7, Dm7, G7/B, Cmaj7, the borrowed bVII, #ivø7). Click a key on the circle, step the mode, switch Staff/MIDI and the span, change Spelling, turn Hold off.

CD1  Circle of fifths: twelve keys, clockwise in fifths. The key's seven notes tinted bg-200, sounding notes uv, the root filled uv. The chosen tonic is the window's one amber mark. Key + mode in its centre, with the signature.
CD2  One readout: the chord as the key writes it (Bb in C major, not A#), its roman numeral beside it, the words under it, then the notes and the other readings of the same notes (ALSO).
CD3  History, scrolling right to left in the host's bars, now at the right edge. Staff: proportional notation, a head at each onset and a tail for its length, the key signature, chord names at each change. MIDI: one line per note, numbered at each C.
CD4  Keyboard: four octaves, held keys lit, the bass marked underneath.
CD5  Hold keeps the last chord after release: the readout stays in ink with a HELD LED, the lit keys dim to uv-deep. The sustain pedal is reported by an LED.
CD6  No animated Ground (a utility window, as Listen-In), so no Motion switch. Zoom (75–150 %) sits in the History header beside Span: the hint bar's one control slot is the Motion switch's, a text-line tall.

As built: plugins/chord-detector (JUCE 9, the native kit), v2026.10.07.1.

Each view is its own reusable JUCE component: Keyboard, CircleOfFifths, ChordReadout, GrandStaff and PianoRoll over one NoteHistory.

Window: 760 × 616.
